title: Mobsters want protection money

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: We need to raise some petty cash boss. For... miscellaneous expenses. For the two gents who came in yesterday.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We need to raise some petty cash boss. For... miscellaneous expenses. For the two gents who came in yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Well they were large and insistent. Rough looking fellas. Floss their teeth with nails. That type. They run a securities business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well they were large and insistent. Rough looking fellas. Floss their teeth with nails. That type. They run a securities business.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: It's a protection racket for sure. We just need to consider how we handle it. They have muscle and we have... cheap mayo and a leaky roof.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a protection racket for sure. We just need to consider how we handle it. They have muscle and we have... cheap mayo and a leaky roof.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: That's what I think too. But what if we... nah. Forget it. Let's just pay them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's what I think too. But what if we... nah. Forget it. Let's just pay them.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Easier said than done. And it's not even easy to SAY. If they heard us talk like this, they'd review bomb the place.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Easier said than done. And it's not even easy to SAY. If they heard us talk like this, they'd review bomb the place.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: I mean the Old Man never paid protection money. He always had schemes to get out of paying. Do you have any... schemes?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean the Old Man never paid protection money. He always had schemes to get out of paying. Do you have any... schemes?

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Well... look into it. If we need to pay, we need to pay. But I'm sure you could come up with something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well... look into it. If we need to pay, we need to pay. But I'm sure you could come up with something.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I have some suggestions on how you may avoid paying these unsavory gents.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have some suggestions on how you may avoid paying these unsavory gents.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I have identified three possible options you could pursue to avoid paying the mobsters. There are three individuals who could help you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have identified three possible options you could pursue to avoid paying the mobsters. There are three individuals who could help you.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: We could recruit a friendly face to get them onside with a kind word in their ear. Or we could try to obtain legal protection through the official channels - CorpSec.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We could recruit a friendly face to get them onside with a kind word in their ear. Or we could try to obtain legal protection through the official channels - CorpSec.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: The cheery donut salesman Danny Danetti has no doubt dealt with such criminals before. He seems willing to help anyone who deals honestly with him, even if they are a rival.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The cheery donut salesman Danny Danetti has no doubt dealt with such criminals before. He seems willing to help anyone who deals honestly with him, even if they are a rival.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: The local CorpSec representative is Agent Teleshko, but his intransigence suggests he wouldn't be the best source of help. Instead, we could ask someone with CorpSec connections. My sources say Hanz Grundown might have such connections.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The local CorpSec representative is Agent Teleshko, but his intransigence suggests he wouldn't be the best source of help. Instead, we could ask someone with CorpSec connections. My sources say Hanz Grundown might have such connections.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It's risky... Really risky. But if Gideon was on your side, you'd have no problems with criminals. You'd have no problem with anyone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's risky... Really risky. But if Gideon was on your side, you'd have no problems with criminals. You'd have no problem with anyone.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I've kept tracers on him in case you chose this option. Let's hope friendship is the key to success.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've kept tracers on him in case you chose this option. Let's hope friendship is the key to success.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I've kept tracers on him in case you chose this option. Let's hope the authorities are the key to success.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've kept tracers on him in case you chose this option. Let's hope the authorities are the key to success.

nodes.text: I've kept tracers on him in case you chose this option. Let's hope ruthlessness is the key to success.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've kept tracers on him in case you chose this option. Let's hope ruthlessness is the key to success.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Though the moral high ground might not be as effective as going low - and getting some more unsavory allies of our own.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Though the moral high ground might not be as effective as going low - and getting some more unsavory allies of our own.
